text: Do you know NASA touched an asteroid, and it almost swallowed the spacecraft?
This is OSIRIS-REx, built from NASA's own 3D model. In October twenty twenty, it reached down to the asteroid Bennu.
Its arm touched the surface, and blew a puff of gas to stir up dust and pebbles into its collector.
But the surface was barely held together. The arm sank almost half a metre, like punching into a ball pit.
About six seconds after contact, it fired its thrusters to back away. It was still sinking. Without them, it would have sunk right into Bennu.
In September twenty twenty-three, the sample capsule landed in the Utah desert.
Then two of the thirty-five fasteners on the sample head would not come off, with the tools allowed in the sealed glovebox.
Engineers designed new tools. In January twenty twenty-four, the last of the sample was finally reached.
Some work needs a sealed room. On Orbi Transfer, one tap takes your team private.
A private space with its own passcode. Everyone on your Wi-Fi gets a one-tap invite, and your tasks move with you.
